t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Yellow and dark pink gnomes mostly had higher results, especially than red. Remember which colors are good

vb_textbox.text: The colors of the gnomes that lead you to more mushrooms varies. My best strategy would be: between colors A and B, first choose one at random. Say you chose A. Take note of whether it is relatively high or low. Then, those same colors are typically shown again (not always but usually!) This time, choose B and note if it is higher or lower than A. It is best to do this on a x1 round, in case B is a dud. And if A gave a very high number, and the round is x5, it may be better to just stick with it for now. Remember which color gave you better results. Stick with this color when it is an option, unless pitted against an entirely new color, C. It is best to choose C when the stakes are lower (x1), but it is important to find out how that color fares relatively quickly, before it changes. Continue to remember the high yield colors and choose those. Eventually, you will notice a color that you had success with now leads to far fewer mushrooms. At this point, start from scratch to find out what the new high yield colors are. Some other things I believe I discovered: size of hat, color of the basket, and which side the gnomes are on does not seem to make a difference. Of course, take this advice at your own risk. However, following this method led me to score roughly 4000 points for reference :) Best of luck!
